title: Tissue TG & TC Protocol
author: Peter Havel
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.62thgen

steps.title: Homogenize Tissue
steps.instruction: Weigh out a minimum of 50 mg of tissue accurately and record the weight. Transfer the tissue to a mortar and pestle with 2 g of sodium sulfate (Fisher S415-212) and grind until completely homogenous with the salt.

steps.title: Initial Extraction
steps.instruction: Transfer the homogenized mix to a 16×125 mm screw-cap glass tube (Fisher 14-959-35A) using a funnel (Fisher 03-865). Add 4 ml of ACS grade methanol (Fisher A412-4) and 8 ml of ACS grade chloroform (Fisher C298-4) using volumetric pipets (Fisher 13-650-2E and 13-650-2J respectively). Screw on the cap (Fisher 14-959-36A), vortex, and store overnight at 4°C.

steps.title: Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Add 2.4 ml of a 0.7% sodium chloride (Fisher S271-3) solution to each tube. Do not vortex. Store for at least 24 hours at 4°C to allow the liquid to separate into two phases (salt solution and methanol on top, chloroform on bottom).

steps.title: Chloroform Recovery
steps.instruction: Aspirate off the supernatant and any floating particulate matter, taking care not to remove too much chloroform. Use a volumetric pipet (Fisher 13-650-2F) to take a 5 ml sample of the chloroform and transfer it into a 16×125 mm open top glass test tube (Fisher 14-961-30).

steps.title: Evaporation
steps.instruction: Place the test tubes containing the chloroform sample into the Evap-O-Rac (Cole-Parmer EW-01610-25) and evaporate with 100% nitrogen gas until completely dry (approximately 4 hours).

steps.title: Solubilization and Clarification
steps.instruction: Add ACS grade 2-propanol (Fisher A417-4) to each tube (estimated volumes: 0.25 ml for liver, 0.15 ml for muscle). Vortex at high speed for 1 minute with parafilm over the tube, then transfer the 2-propanol to a microfuge tube. Centrifuge the microfuge tube for 1 min at 10,000×g to remove tissue bits, then transfer the clean supernatant to a capped threaded microfuge tube (Fisher 02-681-339, cap Fisher 02-681-358).

steps.title: Reagent Preparation
steps.instruction: Reconstitute powdered TG or TC reagent with 25 ml of distilled water to create a 2X solution.

steps.title: Assay Plate Setup
steps.instruction: Add 150 μl of PBS to each well, ensuring no bubbles are introduced. Add 3 μl of calibrator and sample to each well. Read the plate at 540 nm.

substeps.instruction: Add PBS first to prevent the 3 μl sample of 2-propanol from evaporating quickly.

steps.title: Enzymatic Reaction
steps.instruction: Add 150 μl of 2X reagent to each well. Incubate at 37°C for 5 minutes, then read at 540 nm.

steps.title: Data Calculation
steps.instruction: Subtract blank readings from final readings. Calculate unknown samples as: (Sample Absorbance ÷ Calibrator Absorbance) × Calibrator Concentration.

steps.title: Final Concentration Conversion
steps.instruction: Convert the assay TG or TC value from mg/dl to mg/ml. Multiply by the total ml of 2-propanol used to find the total mg in the 5 ml chloroform sample. Multiply by the ratio of total chloroform used to the sample taken (8/5) to get total mg extracted. Divide by the tissue weight to determine mg of TG or TC per g of tissue.
